newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russian currency reserves rose in March - c.bank.
newsitem.headline: Russian currency reserves rose in March - c.bank.

text.p: The liquid portion of Russia's currency reserves rose in March by $1.5 billion to $12 billion, a senior central bank official said on Monday.
"Now the part of the reserves in liquid form, which I said should be about $10 billion, that part today is about more than $12 billion," deputy chairman Alexander Potyomkin told a briefing.
Total foreign exchange reserves now amount to $17 billion, including gold reserves of 400 tonnes, he said.
